deploy-bot: config-only deploy requested by @ron for change window 23:00-00:00 UTC. Changes: reduce batching.window and tighten request_timeout. canary: 3% for 20m, manual hold. runbook: https://go/runbooks/config-mini-roll :gear:
ron: diff snippet:
```
service:
  batching:
    window_ms: 35
  timeouts:
    request_timeout_s: 8
```
liz: please pin model variant rwd-v2-0315 for canary, add observability for p95, 5xx, and tenant queue length. ops_clara will run preflight at 22:30 UTC.
ops_clara: preflight done 22:32 UTC. smoke OK (200), p95 ~52ms. alerts created: ALRT-4990 (p95 reg), ALRT-4991 (5xx).
ron: starting canary @deploy-bot start --thread 1798887770 --canary 3 --hold-after 20m --pin rwd-v2-0315
deploy-bot: canary started id=cfg-canary-179888, canary_percent=3, pinned_model=rwd-v2-0315
monitoring-bot: t+7m: p95 +5ms, errors 0.02%.
monitoring-bot: t+18m: p95 +22ms -> firing ALRT-4990. errors 0.4% but below hard threshold.
liz: seeing p95 jump. traces show headroom starvation on a subset of pods. recommend abort and rollback to previous config.
ron: rolling back now. @deploy-bot rollback cfg-canary-179888
deploy-bot: rollback initiated, ETA ~90s.
monitoring-bot: post-rollback t+3m: p95 back to baseline, errors 0.01%.
ops_clara: root cause note: reducing timeout + smaller batching window increased burstiness causing queuing on tenants with low concurrency. action: split changes into two PRs — (A) batching.window only, (B) timeout only. run batching-only in daytime with 1% canary first.
liz: agreed. ron, schedule batching-only for tomorrow morning and leave model pinned. closing thread; follow-up PR link expected. :white_check_mark:
